text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
Kawakami Princess has claimed the Yushun 
Himba completely undefeated!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (Uwoooooah—!!)

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text: ...U-Ughhh...!

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text: I'm sorry, Mom, Dad...! Trainer...!

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text: I'm sowwy... Ku-chan senpai...!

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text: Daaammiiiit!!

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
Miss Pandora...! Ugh, you worked so 
hard...!

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
I was deeply moved by the way you ran... 
truly. ...Thank you!

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
"O-Oops—I have to make sure to tell them! 
'Great work out there. Keep doing your 
best. I'll always be cheering for you!'"

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text: "...―― 'I'll keep doing my best too!'"

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And so, Fusaichi Pandora's "Oaks" came to 
a close!

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text: Haaah...

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text: Mmm~~gh, Ah, jeez, switch gears!

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
(...I'll make up for today in the Shuka 
Sho! If I give it my all, I totally got 
this!)

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text: (That dreamlike scenery, surely—)

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text: ...Will it... reach...?

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
(First off, isn't this totally different 
from my ideal right now?)

text_block_list.name: Fans in Dream
text_block_list.text: Pandora! Pandora! Pandora! Pandora!

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
(—A sparkling dream I absolutely want to 
make come true in the Twinkle Series.)

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
(A precious dream... that I truly want to 
make come true before it all ends—)

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
"With things like this right now... 
...will we really make it in time?"

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text: "...―― Ah, crap,"

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text: My head is spinning, I hate it!

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
(It's Trainer. "I'm at the east gate." 
..."K, omw!")

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
Nnh, nnnggggh...!! Aaaargh, I don't get 
it!!

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
(—Well, if I try my best, it'll work out 
somehow!)

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
(That's how it's always been... up until 
now!)

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text: So・De・li・cious♡
choice_data_list: You really did great out there...!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Regrettably, I was unable to translate 
Fusaichi Pandora's hard work into a 
victory.

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
"...Well, but hey. Next time, right? Next 
time, next time! Yeah?"

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
Next is the Shuka Sho! Let's, like, 
totally give it our all!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The Shuka Sho—the final leg of the Triple 
Tiara. A GⅠ race held in Kyoto during 
autumn, gathering the fiercest contenders.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Indeed, there is no use crying over 
spilled milk. All that matters now is 
victory at the Shuka Sho...!

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text: ...Right!

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
...So, Trainer. You know how I said 
earlier that I wanna sweep GⅠ races in a 
sprint?

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
"Man, I seriously wanna win the Shuka Sho. 
This time, I'm gonna open the curtain on 
the legend of Pandora."

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
Aaaand... I wanna drop a bomb and hear the 
greatest cheer in history soon!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
It's a lofty ideal. But, considering her 
feelings of wanting to do it "before it 
ends," I should approach this with just as 
much dedication.
choice_data_list:
Got it, let's give it our all with that in 
mind!

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text: Yeah!

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text: ...Hey, I can do this, right?

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text: Mm! Mfufuâ¡

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
“—The final leg of the Triple Tiara, the 
Shuka Sho. Chasing after that glorious 
dream, I want to dash all the way 
through!”
